description.plain: The M1 Sofa Three Seater features a low-profile, minimalist design that brings effortless style to any space. As the original boneless couch, it's built without heavy wood or metal frames. Instead, individual modules connect seamlessly with hidden zippers, making it easy to assemble, expand, and reconfigure. The couch arrives in a box for simple, tool-free setup. Crafted with high-performance materials and powered by SmartFoam™, it delivers lasting comfort and support. Ideal for modern homes.

description.plain: The 4-Seat Modular Sofa is the perfect choice to add an extra layer of sophistication and style to your living room. With its contemporary design and comfortable fabric upholstery, this piece speaks elegance without compromising on practicality. This sleek and modern sofa is sure to become a showstopper in any room. Perfect for entertaining family and friends, the 4-Seat Modular Sofa offers comfort and style all in one! Made with soft yet hard-wearing material that will last no matter how often it's used, this sofa will upgrade your home while keeping you and your guests relaxed. Whether you're looking for luxurious modern furniture or just seeking out an update, the 4-Seat Modular Sofa is sure to meet all expectations.
